I can’t continue working in the background or send results later unless a real automation/reminder tool is created and confirmed. I won’t be able to do background research after this turn.

I can help right now — or set up a scheduled delivery if you enable an automation tool (calendar/email/reminder) and confirm the exact action. Which would you prefer?

If you want me to research now, please tell me:
- Topic and specific questions or scope
- Deadline/time “later today” (e.g., by 5:00 PM your time)
- Preferred sources or required authority level (news, academic, gov, etc.)
- Deliverable format (short summary, bullet points, full report, citations)
- Any constraints (length, number of sources, regions, paywalled sources to avoid)

If you want a scheduled delivery instead, tell me which tool to use (calendar event, email, or a reminder) and confirm permission to create/send it — and provide the recipient address/timezone details.
